After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Farstine|victory]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farstine]], a '''battle''' took place at the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] between the Galactic Empire and the [[Trade Federation resistance|resisting]] parts of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] company. After Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Octavian Grant]] chased the resistance's leader, [[Customs Vizier]] [[Marath Vooro]], down the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] from Farstine to the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], his forces managed to capture Vooro during the battle. The arrest ended the [[Five Veils Campaign]], an Imperial campaign against Federation holdouts led by Vooro, who had refused to acknowledge a [[Imperial–Trade Federation treaty|treaty]] that handed over the Federation's assets to the Empire.<ref name="War" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].<ref name="War" />
